hero.title: What Should You Wear on a Ritz-Carlton Yacht?
hero.subtitle: Think resort chic, not formal cruise wear. A complete guide to Yacht Casual daytime comfort and Yacht Sophisticated dinner attire.
readMoreParagraphs: One of the most common questions travelers ask before sailing with The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection is surprisingly simple: 'What am I supposed to wear?' The answer is reassuring: you do not need to pack a tuxedo, formal gown or collection of traditional cruise-night outfits.

The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection is intentionally more relaxed than a traditional formal cruise. The overall style is polished, sophisticated and resort-inspired. During the day, think: Yacht Casual. For dinner in the indoor restaurants, think: Yacht Sophisticated. The goal is to look elegant without feeling overdressed.
The official Ritz-Carlton guidance states that there are no formal nights onboard and that jackets and ties are not required. Collared shirts, slacks and elegant attire are recommended for dinner.

quickAnswer.title: What Is the Ritz-Carlton Yacht Dress Code?
quickAnswer.description: The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection generally describes its onboard dress code as Yacht Casual, meaning resort wear or smart-casual clothing is appropriate. For dinner in the indoor restaurants, the evening dress code is Yacht Sophisticated, described as resort-chic and elegant-casual attire.

rulesSuitability.title: Dress Code Standards: Permitted vs. Dinner Restrictions
rulesSuitability.subtitle: Understanding the boundary between relaxed daytime settings and evening dining venues.

permittedList.title: Yacht Casual by Day
permittedList.description: Polished shorts, polos, linen shirts, sundresses, resort sets, and clean sneakers around outdoor decks and lounges.

permittedList.title: Pool & Marina Swimwear
permittedList.description: Swimsuits and rash guards are completely appropriate around pools and the Marina; use an elegant cover-up when moving indoors.

permittedList.title: No Formal Nights Required
permittedList.description: You do not need to pack tuxedos or ball gowns; dinners are designed around resort chic rather than black-tie formality.

permittedList.title: Specialty Dining & S.E.A.
permittedList.description: Indoor restaurants and Chef Sven Elverfeld's S.E.A. follow Yacht Sophisticated (collared shirts, slacks, elegant dresses).

permittedList.title: Themed Night Participation
permittedList.description: Voyages may feature fun themes like En Blanc, Disco Nights, or Havana Nights as optional festive opportunities.

notPermittedList.title: Shorts at Dinner
notPermittedList.description: Shorts are specifically listed among items not permitted during dinner service in indoor restaurants.

notPermittedList.title: Flip-Flops at Dinner
notPermittedList.description: Flip-flops are reserved for pool, beach, and Marina; switch to loafers, flats, sandals, or dress shoes at dinner.

notPermittedList.title: Ball Caps & Hats at Dinner
notPermittedList.description: Ball caps and hats are not permitted during dinner service; sun hats are for daytime outdoor excursions only.

notPermittedList.title: Swimwear in Dining Venues
notPermittedList.description: Swimwear should never be worn into indoor dining venues or evening restaurants without changing.

notPermittedList.title: Sleeveless T-Shirts
notPermittedList.description: Sleeveless shirts for men are not permitted in indoor dining venues during dinner hours.

questions.question: What is the dress code on Ritz-Carlton yachts?
questions.answer: The general dress code is Yacht Casual, meaning resort wear or smart-casual clothing is appropriate. Dinner in the indoor restaurants follows a Yacht Sophisticated dress code, which means elegant-casual or resort-chic attire.

questions.question: Are there formal nights on Ritz-Carlton yachts?
questions.answer: No. Ritz-Carlton does not require traditional formal nights, and jackets and ties are not required.

questions.question: Do men need to wear a jacket on Ritz-Carlton yachts?
questions.answer: No. Jackets are not required. A lightweight blazer can be packed optionally for guests who want to dress up for dinner or special occasions.

questions.question: Do men need to wear a tie?
questions.answer: No. Ties are not required.

questions.question: What should men wear to dinner on a Ritz-Carlton yacht?
questions.answer: Collared shirts, slacks or tailored trousers and elegant shoes are recommended. A blazer is optional.

questions.question: What should women wear to dinner on a Ritz-Carlton yacht?
questions.answer: Elegant casual or resort-chic clothing works well, including dresses, skirts, jumpsuits, elegant trousers and polished tops with appropriate evening footwear.

questions.question: Can you wear shorts to dinner?
questions.answer: No. Shorts are not permitted during dinner service.

questions.question: Can you wear flip-flops to dinner?
questions.answer: No. Flip-flops are not permitted during dinner service.

questions.question: Can you wear a baseball cap to dinner?
questions.answer: No. Ball caps and hats are not permitted during dinner service.

questions.question: Can you wear jeans on a Ritz-Carlton yacht?
questions.answer: Polished jeans may be appropriate in some casual daytime settings, but travelers should choose more elevated trousers, dresses or resort wear for dinner.

questions.question: Can you wear swimwear around the yacht?
questions.answer: Yes, in appropriate pool, Marina and water-activity areas. A cover-up should be used when moving into other areas.

questions.question: Do I need formalwear for a Ritz-Carlton yacht cruise?
questions.answer: No. You do not need a tuxedo, formal gown or traditional cruise formalwear.

questions.question: What does Yacht Sophisticated mean?
questions.answer: Yacht Sophisticated is Ritz-Carlton's evening dress standard for indoor dining. It means resort-chic or elegant-casual clothing rather than formalwear.

questions.question: What does Yacht Casual mean?
questions.answer: Yacht Casual means polished resort wear or smart-casual clothing. It is appropriate for daytime activities and the general relaxed atmosphere onboard.

questions.question: What shoes should I bring?
questions.answer: Bring comfortable walking shoes for excursions, casual/resort footwear for daytime, and elegant sandals, flats, loafers or dress shoes for dinner.

questions.question: Should I pack a blazer?
questions.answer: A blazer is optional. It can be useful for a special dinner, cocktail reception, cooler evening or celebration.

questions.question: Should I pack a dress for every night?
questions.answer: No. A small capsule wardrobe is usually more practical. Choose versatile dresses and separates that can be styled differently throughout the voyage.

questions.question: Are themed nights formal?
questions.answer: Not necessarily. Some voyages may feature themed evenings such as En Blanc, Disco Nights or Havana Nights. These are opportunities to participate in the theme rather than traditional formal nights.

questions.question: Does the dress code change between Evrima, Ilma and Luminara?
questions.answer: The overall dress philosophy applies across the Ritz-Carlton yacht fleet, but individual venues and themed events can vary. Guests should check the current information for their specific sailing.

questions.question: Is the Ritz-Carlton yacht dress code strict?
questions.answer: It is relaxed compared with traditional luxury cruising, but dinner venues still have clear expectations. The easiest approach is resort casual during the day and elevated resort-chic attire at night.
